title: Physician-Pharmacist Collaboration for Osteoporotic Patient Follow-up
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the follow-up of the osteoporotic patient by a physician-pharmacist collaboration.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* older than 18 years old
* having an osteoporosis treatment
* following a Therapeutical Education for Patient

Exclusion Criteria:

* opposition for anonymised data gathering
study_population: Patient having osteoporosis enrolled into the programm of Therapeutical Educational for patient
